rationale: The trainer does not implement the frozen proposal: it adds BETA_COMMIT/BETA_CODE configuration but never uses them; RQVAE.forward sets loss_bal to zero, while the epoch balance is added outside the model only to the first batch (not a full-population term in every objective as specified). More importantly, the assignment implementation's large-group path is auction plus single-item moves/swaps, not an exact global transportation solver or a lexicographic-optimality certificate; the source itself acknowledges this. The math suite tests exactness only on a tiny case that takes the separate exhaustive solver, and tests Sinkhorn against a duplicated iteration formula. Gradient and DDP suites use a tiny RQVAE/batch, but do not independently validate objective values; DDP checks rank agreement on identical input, not independently expected updates. Entrypoint checks artifacts and finiteness, not frozen numerical behavior. Thus the central mechanism is not validated and is materially off-proposal.
